---
title: "11 | Miracles, Signs, and Wonders"
author: "C.O."
date: "November 2026"
draft: false
---

When we think of miracles, signs, or wonders, we think of something that is grand in appearance. It is nice when this happens: many are encouraged and believe. As I grow in my walk with the LORD, I have noticed the miracles, signs, and wonders in everyday life: a pregnancy that goes full-term, the sun that rises and sets, breathing in and out, and the wind that propels an airplane. LORD, thank you for the everyday miracles.

Meditate on these verses to gain wisdom:

-   Week 1
    -   Isaiah 29:18-19
-   Week 2
    -   Acts 19:11-12
-   Week 3
    -   Matthew 14:17-19
-   Week 4
    -   Romans 15:19
